cards.title: Emma Johnson
cards.description: Frontend developer with eight years building design systems and component libraries. Obsessed with animation performance and zero-layout-shift experiences.
cards.highlight: The person who makes every interface feel alive.

cards.title: Michael Chen
cards.description: Backend engineer specialising in distributed systems and cloud-native architecture. Has kept five-nines uptime across three consecutive product launches.
cards.highlight: The engineer who sleeps well because the system never goes down.

cards.title: Sophia Martinez
cards.description: UI/UX designer who bridges research and production. Every decision she makes is backed by user data and challenged by aesthetic intuition.
cards.highlight: Turns user pain into interfaces people actually enjoy.

cards.title: Liam Brown
cards.description: DevOps engineer who automated himself out of weekend on-call rotations. Infrastructure as code evangelist with a deep love for Terraform and quiet Sundays.
cards.highlight: Automated the job so well he had to find a harder one.

cards.title: Olivia Davis
cards.description: Product manager who has taken two products from zero to a million users. Sharp on prioritisation, ruthless about scope, and deeply trusted by every engineer she works with.
cards.highlight: Ships products engineers are proud to have built.

cards.title: Noah Wilson
cards.description: Mobile developer with a catalogue of twelve shipped iOS apps and a reputation for buttery smooth gesture-driven interfaces.
cards.highlight: Twelve apps shipped. Zero one-star reviews.

cards.title: Ava Taylor
cards.description: QA engineer who built the team's entire testing infrastructure from scratch. Found 47 critical bugs before the last major release shipped.

cards.title: James Anderson
cards.description: Security specialist who has conducted penetration tests across fourteen enterprise clients and never left without finding something the team missed.
cards.highlight: Finds the hole before the attacker does.

cards.title: Mia Thomas
cards.description: Marketing strategist who grew organic traffic from 4K to 180K monthly visitors in fourteen months without a single paid campaign.

cards.title: Ethan White
cards.description: Data analyst who built the company's entire analytics stack and turned raw event data into the dashboards leadership actually uses every morning.
cards.highlight: Turns noise into the three numbers that actually matter.

cards.title: Isabella Harris
cards.description: Full-stack developer who owns the entire codebase of the company's core product solo and still ships faster than most two-person teams.
cards.highlight: One person. One codebase. Faster than your whole team.

cards.title: Lucas Garcia
cards.description: Machine learning engineer who built the recommendation engine that increased user retention by 34% in its first quarter of deployment.
cards.highlight: The model that made 34% more users stay.
